name: Herbed Tomato Soup
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 tbsp fresh snipped basil (or 1 tsp dried)
1 tsp fresh snipped thyme (or ¼ tsp dried)
4–6 fresh basil leaves (optional), sliced thinly into strips

steps: In a 2-quart saucepan, sauté onion in olive oil until tender but not browned.
Add tomatoes, broth, tomato sauce, basil, thyme and pepper.
Reduce heat, cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in vinegar, if desired, just prior to serving.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with basil strips.

culture.text: Tomato soup is a soup with tomatoes as the primary ingredient. It can be served hot or cold, and may be made in a variety of ways. It may be smooth in texture, and there are also recipes that include chunks of tomato, cream, chicken or vegetable stock, vermicelli, chunks of other vegetables and meatballs. Many countries have their own versions of tomato soup which all vary in taste, portions and ingredients.
